findings.claim: The release-candidate workflow declares an unsupported GitHub Actions permission key, so the workflow will fail validation before running the rehearsal or staging jobs.
findings.evidence: The rehearse job permissions block adds `artifact-metadata: write` alongside `contents`, `id-token`, and `attestations`; `artifact-metadata` is not a valid GitHub Actions `permissions` scope.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove `artifact-metadata: write` from the job permissions block and keep only supported scopes required by the attestation/upload steps, e.g. `contents: read`, `id-token: write`, and `attestations: write`.
